orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Ramesh Ranganathan,Hon'ble Mr. Justice Ramesh Chandra Khulbe
orders.text:
WPSB No.137 of 2020 
Hon’ble Ramesh Ranganathan, C.J.
Hon’ble R. C. Khulbe, J.
Mr. Vivek Shukla, learned Counsel for the 
petitioners. 
Mr. K.N. Joshi, learned Deputy Advocate 
General for the State of Uttarakhand. 
Mr. Vivek Shukla, learned Counsel for the 
petitioners submits that the constitutional validity 
of the Uttarakhand (Technical Education) Gazetted 
Officers Service Rule 2009 has not been subjected 
to challenge; and the petitioner would take steps to 
amend the pleadings, and the prayer in the writ 
petition, to include a challenge thereto. 
He requests three weeks’ time to file such an 
application. 
Post after three weeks. 
 
 (R.C. Khulbe, J.) (Ramesh Ranganathan, C.J.)
 07.07.2020 
Balwant/Sukhbant

orders.text:
WPSB No. 137 of 2020
Hon’ble Ravi Malimath, ACJ.
Hon’ble N.S. Dhanik, J.
Shri Vivek Shukla, learned 
counsel for the petitioners. 
Shri C. S. Rawat, learned 
additional chief standing counsel for the 
State. 
By the order dated 07.07.2020, 
time was granted to the petitioner’s 
counsel to enable to make a requisite 
application seeking to challenge the 
constitutional validity of the 
Uttarakhand (Technical Education) 
Gazetted Officers Service Rule, 2009. 
Learned counsel for the petitioner 
submits that he will argue the petition 
without such an application and based 
on the prayer that already exists in the 
writ petition. 
His submission is placed on 
record. 
Issue notice on application for 
amendment. 
Post after service of notice. 
Misc. application with
supplementary affidavit (IA No. 7050 of 
2020) is taken on record. 
Urgency application (IA No. 7052 
of 2020) disposed off. 
 (N.S. Dhanik, J.) (Ravi Malimath, ACJ.)
 18.08.2020

Hon’ble Alok Mahra, J.
 Mr. B.S. Koranga, Advocate holding brief of 
Mr. Vivek Shukla, Advocate for the petitioners. 
 Mr. J.S. Virk, Deputy Advocate General 
with Mr. Rakesh Joshi, Brief Holder for the 
State.
 Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, Advocate for 
respondent no.6.
 This petition was filed in the year 2020. On 
18.08.2020, on behalf of the petitioner it was 
submitted that the matter would be argued 
based on the prayer that has already exist in 
the writ petition. Notices were served 
thereafter. On 13.02.2026, none was present. 
Today, learned counsel appearing for the 
petitioner seeks adjournment. 
 This is very sorry state of affairs. A petition 
that was filed six years ago, has not been 
argued and adjournment is being sought. 
 Be it as it may, list on 16.03.2026.
 On that date, the matter shall be called out 
and the Court shall proceed to decide the case 
without entertaining any adjournment. 
 
(Alok Mahra , J.) (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 20.02.2026
Sanjay
